scope: 开场前两页 SFC 像素风试版；原图与后三页保留
processing: 仅复制内置绘图输出，无像素化滤镜、重采样、裁切或图片处理依赖。

steps.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: opening story illustration 1 of 5 for the game BakaFactory.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its narrative, wide cinematic framing and main composition, but completely redraw the illustration as beautiful authentic SFC/SNES 16-bit pixel art, NOT a filtered or pixelated photograph.
Keep the scene: left foreground industrial billboard with smiling Earth encircled by green recycling arrows, sleek white human emigrant starliners departing in upper left space, a receding convoy of boxy scrap freighters approaching Earth with the largest loaded freighter in upper right, sunset horizon and immense scrap islands under lavender and coral clouds. Keep their positions and perspective. Preserve the humor and warm optimistic science-fiction mood.
Style: clean handcrafted 16-bit game cutscene, effective drawing grid approximately 480x270, visibly square consistent pixel clusters, crisp stair-step contours, 1-pixel dark violet outlines at that grid, limited cohesive palette around 48 colors, 3-4 flat shading steps per material. Large readable silhouettes and deliberately simplified clusters for scrap appliances. Rich cyan/indigo/lavender/pink/coral with warm gold light. Broad clean color fields, stepped pixel cloud shapes, sparse individually placed square stars. Pixel art at every scale including ships and clouds. No smooth painterly rendering. Wide 16:9 landscape.
Remove the excessive rust, noise, dirt and distressed surface texture in the source. Billboard and hulls have clean intact enamel, only a few carefully placed seams or edge wear. The scrapyard is organized readable shapes, not granular visual noise.
Billboard text (verbatim, large clear pixel Chinese): "您的文明，我们善后". Keep smiling Earth sign. No additional text or captions, no page numbers, no watermark, no outer frame, no UI. Avoid: photorealism, smooth gradients, antialiasing, blur, film grain, paper texture, dithering fields, stippling, rusty speckling, scanlines, CRT overlay, tiny illegible detail. Redraw from scratch in pixel vocabulary rather than applying a mosaic effect.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: opening story illustration 2 of 5 for BakaFactory.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the original BAKA-01 promotion scene. Input image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the newly approved-in-this-pass clean pixel opening space scene; use its square pixel vocabulary, clarity, saturated lavender/coral/cyan/gold palette, not its subject.
Completely redraw image 1 as an authentic SFC/SNES 16-bit pixel-art game cutscene that matches image 2. Preserve the wide 16:9 framing, character identity, narrative and main composition: seated BAKA-01 in left-center foreground, promotion terminal on far left, six colorful department pictograms in two rows of three on back wall, a long paper checklist held in raised mechanical pincer and winding past six EMPTY office chairs across right side; sunset scrapyard and crane carrying an appliance visible through open workshop bay on right. No humans, no extra robots.
Character invariants: squat cream rectangular robot head with navy screen and two cyan eyes, one pink-ball antenna, mustard yellow chest with hazard trim, teal scarf, metal PINCER hands (never human palms), sturdy red work boots. Seated tired-but-endearing newly promoted chief, identical proportions and pose to the original. Preserve all six department pictograms (factory, box, lightning, wrench, ID card, broom).
Style: clean handcrafted 16-bit cutscene art with effective drawing grid about 480x270 and visibly consistent square pixel clusters, crisp stair-step silhouettes and dark violet pixel outlines. Limited cohesive palette around 48 colors, 3-4 deliberate flat shading steps per surface. Simplify complex scrap into readable appliances. Broad CLEAN ivory enamel and yellow metal surfaces with only a few seams; paper is clean cream, scarf solid teal folds, floor clean stepped shading, sparse intentional wear only. Warm gold light and lavender shadows, vivid cyan screen and pink sign. Same pixel scale and color handling as image 2. Every object must be redrawn in pixel art, not merely a mosaic filter over the painting.
Terminal text (verbatim, large readable pixel Chinese): "岗位调整通知" and "厂长" on a gold medal. Character label: "BAKA-01". Checklist uses large simple checkbox and line glyphs instead of tiny fake lettering. No added captions, narration, page number, speech bubble, watermark, outer frame or UI.
Remove the original's excessive rust and granular noise: no random brown speckles on robot, chairs, paper, wall or floor. Avoid painterly brushwork, realistic textures, smooth gradients, antialiasing, blur, film grain, paper texture, heavy dithering, stippling, grime, CRT/scanline overlays. Keep industrial storytelling but visually clear, crisp and friendly like a polished SFC story illustration.

Use case: style-transfer / clean-up refinement.
Input is the EDIT TARGET, a pixel-art opening story scene. Retain EXACT scene composition, all objects, crop, Chinese wording, BAKA-01 label and robot identity. Keep the existing true square-pixel / 16-bit SNES cutscene medium. Refine ONLY visual clarity and surface rendering.
CRITICAL CHANGE: eliminate ALL small random rust chips, freckles, stipple, dirt flecks and high-frequency surface noise from EVERY material, especially cream robot head and limbs, yellow torso, red boots, blue terminal casing, department board and pictogram cards, chairs, steel structural beams and background appliances. Do not preserve brown dotted distressing. No worn enamel spots. These should be clean SOLID color regions with large crisp flat shadow shapes. Each metal panel has at most one solid shadow stripe and a thin highlight. The robot yellow chest, ivory face surround, ivory legs, red boots and teal scarf must be beautifully CLEAN.
Target a polished clean SFC-era hand-pixeled adventure story illustration, strong readable silhouettes, deliberate large pixel clusters, effective art grid approximately 400x225, limited harmonious palette, 3 flat shade values per material. Remove unnecessary internal lines and tiny texture; simplify scrap heaps to readable block-shaped appliances with flat fronts and simple screen rectangles. Eliminate texture noise in floor, papers and shelves. Important objects still present and distinct; do not delete character, six department icon tiles, empty chair row, long winding checklist, plant silhouettes, crane, sunset and piled appliances. Broad regions of cream, gold, teal, cobalt and lavender. Beautiful saturated pink/coral sunset, stepped cloud shapes, no mottling. Pixel-edge contours and stepped shading only, no gradients, no painterly or realistic texture.
All existing words stay exactly as-is: "岗位调整通知", "厂长", "BAKA-01". Simplified checkbox lines on clean blank paper. All chairs stay EMPTY. Mechanical PINCER hands stay. No captions, frames, watermark, extra text or UI.
Make the image appreciably simpler, cleaner and calmer than this input, with uninterrupted flat-colored surfaces and no rusty dotted texture, while preserving attractive pixel craft.

Use case: style-transfer / clean-up refinement.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the pixel-art space-contract scene. Input image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for clean solid surfaces and calm readable pixel clusters.
Retain EXACT composition, framing, silhouettes, text and narrative of image 1: left foreground smiling Earth recycling billboard, upper-left sleek white emigrant starliners, upper-right large scrap freighter and receding convoy, coral sunset, lavender cloud ocean and scrap islands. Do NOT import robot, office objects, chairs or any subject from image 2.
Refine only clarity: remove all random brown rust freckles, chipped paint noise, grain and mottled surface texture from cargo freighter hulls, billboard, structural metal and foreground appliances. Use clean flat ivory, indigo and muted steel panels with large warm shadow shapes and crisp pixel highlights. Simplify each scrap appliance to readable block with screen rectangle and 2-3 shade regions, fewer tiny internal marks. No dotted or distressed surface texture.
Clean up starry sky: plain deep indigo and purple horizontal stepped color bands with sparse distinct individually placed square stars; eliminate granular cloudy speckled Milky Way. Keep a sense of space depth with a few larger cross-shaped stars. Clouds remain beautiful broad lavender, pink and gold stair-step clusters with clear flat bands, no noisy dither fields.
Preserve authentic SFC/SNES 16-bit game cutscene pixel art with visible crisp square pixel clusters and stepped dark violet outlines; keep rich color harmony and shape fidelity. Art grid approx 400x225; deliberate chunky details, simplified broad flat color fields and 3 shading values per material, same cleanliness as image 2. No smooth painterly repaint, no gradients, antialiasing, blur, film grain, texture overlays or CRT effects.
Text remains exactly "您的文明，我们善后". No extra text, captions, page numbers, frame, UI or watermark. Maintain full wide 16:9 landscape composition, and all original narrative objects.

notes: step: 表示前序内置绘图结果；未采用的草稿不作为运行资源归档。正式输出直接由内置绘图生成。
